name: Do I need to prepare anything before the stair trim installation begins?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to prepare anything before the stair trim installation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, some preparation can help ensure a smooth installation process. We recommend clearing the staircase and surrounding areas of any furniture, decor, or obstructions. If you have existing flooring or paint nearby, consider protecting it with drop cloths or plastic sheeting. For new constructions or renovations, ensure the subfloor and wall surfaces are ready for trim attachment. Our team will advise on specific preparations during the initial consultation, helping you gather everything needed for efficient project execution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the staircase and surrounding areas of obstructions, and protect nearby flooring/paint. Our team will advise on specific preparations beforehand.
